senses.gloss: m. pl. (בטי) = h. בְּטַח II, אַבְּטַי, column-like receptacles (of water).
units: Lev. R. s. 25 (ref. to בטחות, Job XXXVIII, 36, taking ב as a radical letter, ‘receptacles of wisdom’) מהו בטוחות ב׳ what is battuḥoth? Answ. Bitvaya. [Ar. reads בטיוטא, taking ב as propos., v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. טיטויא, IV, p. 27. Mat. K. guesses at טויא as a name of a bird, as parallel to שכוי.]
